title: DepEd: Public school direct funding to reach P61.02B

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Direct funding for public schools nationwide will reach P61.02 billion under the proposed 2027 National Expenditure Program (NEP), the Department of Education (DepEd) said in a statement issued on Friday. The proposed amount is more than double the 2022 public school funding of around P30 billion in 2022. As DepEd pointed out, an increase in school-level maintenance and other operating expenses (MOOE) is included in DepEd’s proposed P975.96 billion budget for 2027 under the NEP, which recently passed plenary deliberations in the House of Representatives.
